The math club sold 54 cookies at 3 for $1, so the revenue from cookies is \(54 \div 3 = 18\) dollars. They sold 20 cupcakes at $2 each, giving \(20 \times 2 = 40\) dollars. They sold 35 brownies at $1 each, giving \(35 \times 1 = 35\) dollars. The total revenue is \(18 + 40 + 35 = 93\) dollars. The cost to bake the items was $15. Profit is revenue minus cost: \(93 - 15 = 78\) dollars.

Answer: 78
